collection.title: Peugeot 308 Hatchback 2007 to 2013 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Peugeot 308 Hatchback 2007 to 2013 model which requires a 30" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 26" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this 308, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
